title: Operator manages jobs from the web console
description:
The console is read-only apart from the Batch queue toggle. Job Explorer lists
jobs and the detail page inspects one, but neither can act on what it shows.
An operator who spots a wedged clip in the console has to leave for a terminal.

## Feature

```gherkin
Feature: Managing jobs from the web console

  Scenario: Operator deletes a job from the detail page
    Given the operator is viewing a job with status "done"
    When the operator chooses to delete the job and confirms
    Then the job is deleted
    And the operator returns to the job explorer

  Scenario: Delete is guarded by confirmation
    Given the operator is viewing a job with status "done"
    When the operator chooses to delete the job and cancels
    Then the job still exists

  Scenario: Operator regenerates a job from the detail page
    Given the operator is viewing a job with status "done"
    When the operator chooses to regenerate the job
    Then the job status shown becomes "pending"
    And the audio player is no longer offered

  Scenario: Operator retries a failed job from the detail page
    Given the operator is viewing a job with status "failed"
    When the operator chooses to retry the job
    Then the job status shown becomes "pending"

  Scenario: Actions offered match the job status
    Given the operator is viewing a job with status "pending"
    Then no regenerate action is offered
    And no retry action is offered

  Scenario: A failed action reports the reason
    Given the operator is viewing a job with status "claimed" by a live worker
    When the operator chooses to release the claim
    Then the conflict reason is shown
    And the job status shown is still "claimed"
```

## Implementation brief

**`console/lib/api.ts`** — add `deleteJob(hash)`, `regenerateJob(hash)`,
`retryJob(hash, force?)` alongside the existing `fetchJobDetail` /
`toggleQueue`. Match the existing `apiFetch` error handling; do not add a
second fetch wrapper.

**`console/app/jobs/detail/page.tsx`** — an action row on the status card.
Gate each control on `job.status`:

| Status | Delete | Regenerate | Retry / Release |
|---|---|---|---|
| done | yes | yes | no |
| failed | yes | no | yes |
| claimed | yes | no | yes (release, force when live) |
| pending | yes | no | no |

Delete and force-release go through a confirmation dialog. After a successful
mutation, refetch the detail rather than patching local state optimistically.
Surface the API error message on failure -- in particular the 409 conflict
text from the retry story, which is the whole point of the last scenario.

**`console/app/jobs/page.tsx`** — a delete control per row is optional and out
of scope here; the detail page is the management surface.

**`features/`** — Playwright acceptance under `console/tests/`, consistent
with the existing console test setup, plus Gherkin if the behavior is
expressible at the API level.

## Blocked on

The three API stories in this epic. Nothing to call until those land.
